name: The Bodhisattvas of the Ten Stages in Attaining the Most Perfect Knowledge
material: hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
dimensions: Painting: 140.8 x 79.3 cm (55 7/16 x 31 1/4 in.); Overall with knobs: 227.8 x 120 cm (89 11/16 x 47 1/4 in.)
summary: This painting represents bodhisattvas of the 10 stages of enlightenment undergoing the final processes toward Buddhahood.
